quality_gate: Pin matched operating point and evaluate same original sources for baseline/candidate; report TP/FP/FN, P/R/F1 per subtype with denominators and independent group support. No eligible complete GT -> NOT_MEASURABLE/null, never zero-filled accuracy.
Report object AP50/AP50:95 and per-class P/R/recall-by-input-size only on explicitly complete annotations; partial known-positive recall separately.

Report actor-state and episode P/R/F1 on reviewed positive AND verified-negative exposure, matching/uncertainty protocol fixed first; false alerts/time only on exhaustively reviewed negative continuous footage.
Predeclare candidate gain and safety-regression criteria with root before runs, thresholds selected on val only; frozen final test once. No invented absolute accuracy requirement.
Confidence0.25/0.5 and existing posture thresholds are operating parameters, not validated quality guarantees. Source clip classification is not event P/R/F1.
common.taxonomy_gate: Freeze exact ordered mutually exclusive detection leaf classes and source map before training; state/context attributes are separate multi-label tasks. No automatic alias mapping across source datasets.
